# Data (synthetic, generated by `scripts/gen_data.py`, deterministic)
- `accounts.json` id, name, domain, tier (Enterprise/Premier/Standard), renewal, csm, region. Similar names exist (e.g. Acme Corporation / Acme Corp Holdings / Acme Group).
- `usage.json` 12 monthly rows per account (active_users, invoices_processed, logins).
- `tickets.json` ~3,000 history tickets + 10 review tickets (TCK-9001..9010). ~8% have blank `account_id`; `label` values are inconsistent.
- `escalations.json` open/closed escalations per account.
- `kb.json` ~390 articles: `status` current/outdated, `superseded_by`, `related`; `KB-POL-*` are support policies.
- `review_set.txt` the 10 tickets to run.
All foreign keys are valid (`python scripts/validate_data.py`).
